skills.name: Dual-weapon Wielder
skills.text: Each time this fighter attacks with an off-hand weapon, they can make 2 attacks with that weapon instead of 1.

skills.name: Shooting Drills
skills.text: Each time this fighter reloads a weapon, they can make a Willpower test. If they pass, they do not need to forgo a Move or Action, (see *Reload* weapon trait).

skills.name: Great Weapon Master
skills.text: This fighter ignores the ‘Unwieldy’ weapon trait on Melee Weapons.

skills.name: Unshakeable
skills.text: This fighter ignores the *Fear* special rule and all rules that would make them scatter (eg. the *Scare* weapon trait).

skills.name: Tough Bastard
skills.text: Each time this fighter activates while they are **bloodied**, they can take a Willpower test. If they pass, they heal 1 life point and are no longer bloodied.

skills.name: Fast Learner
skills.text: In the Aftermath sequence of each battle, this fighter earns d6 bonus experience.

skills.name: Duellist
skills.text: This fighter can parry critical hits with any successful attack.

skills.name: Steady Aim
skills.text: Add 1 to attack rolls for ranged attacks made by this fighter, while this fighter has not moved in the same activation.
